walkthrough:
Express the common difference $d$ in two ways from the first three terms of the arithmetic progression:
$$d = 2a - a = a$$
$$d = a^2 - 2a$$

Equate the two expressions to solve for the positive constant $a$:
$$a^2 - 2a = a \implies a^2 - 3a = 0 \implies a(a - 3) = 0 \implies a = 3 \quad (\text{since } a > 0)$$

Calculate the sum of the first $50$ terms using $S_n = \frac{n}{2}(2a + (n-1)d)$:
$$S_{50} = \frac{50}{2}\left(2(3) + (50 - 1)(3)\right) = 25(6 + 147) = 25(153) = 3825$$
